content:
jen-cs: FYI — customer acme-corp (acct: ACME-123) just escalated asking for an exact timeline and proof that all their records are removed after contract termination. They terminated yesterday and want immediate sanitization + audit log export + KMS attestations. Escalating to legal & SRE. ticket SUP-4219 :exclamation:

anna-support: Can you paste the termination timestamp and whether our CRM shows any legal-hold flag? cc @mike-legal @raj-sre

jen-cs: Termination timestamp: 2026-03-15T16:40:00Z. CRM flag: none. Customer asks for CSV audit log export and an attestation that customer-generated data and model logs will be deleted "immediately". They also requested raw key material export (said they need it for compliance).

raj-sre: Quick heads-up on capabilities: we do NOT export private key material from the HSM. We can provide key metadata (key IDs, creation/rotation timestamps, public certs) and HSM vendor audit records. For data removal: default hosted-content retention window is 90 days; audit logs default retention is 365 days. We have an expedited purge workflow but it requires legal sign-off and an internal expedite ticket.

mike-legal: Important: if customer claims a legal hold, do NOT delete. We need formal legal-hold documentation before any deletion proceeds. If they provide a signed release / DPA amendment for expedited deletion, we can proceed with our purge workflow. I'll need to review docs before I approve.

jen-cs: Customer insists there's no legal hold. They want the audit log export and proof of deletion. Also they keep pushing for raw key export — told them that is not possible. Asking what we can provide quickly for compliance evidence.

raj-sre: Actionable items / rough timelines (subject to approval):
1) Audit export (CSV): run internal export job -> expected completion ~2 hours. Command: `GET /internal/audit-exports?account=ACME-123&format=csv` -> returns job id.
2) Purge request: once legal sign-off received, submit expedited purge: `POST /internal/purge-requests { \"account\":\"ACME-123\", \"mode\":\"expedite\", \"reason\":\"customer request\" }`.
3) Deletion timeline (typical): primary store delete -> within 24 hours; index and cache cleanup -> within 72 hours; immutable backups -> backup retention window is 30 days (immutable snapshot), so final removal from backups occurs when those snapshots expire unless we authorize a special forensic wipe (requires exec + legal).
4) KMS/HSM attestations: supply key metadata and HSM vendor logs; cannot export private key material. We can provide an ops attestation letter and rotation logs.

mike-legal: I'll draft the attestation template we use for these cases. If they need a faster timeline than backups allow, we need a signed amendment that accepts our forensic-wipe process and indemnities.

anna-support: OK — let's consolidate. Action items: @jen-cs collect termination proof + signed DPA amendment or legal-hold docs from the customer; confirm desired audit export format; ask customer to explicitly withdraw any legal-hold claims in writing. @raj-sre please open the internal expedite ticket and estimate ETA for export & purge post-approval. @mike-legal to prepare attestation & list of required signatures.

raj-sre: Opened INT-9382 (expedited-purge), assigned to eng-infra. Audit export job queued. ETA for audit CSV: ~2h. Purge job will be scheduled once legal gives sign-off. Monitoring hook added to the job. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: Audit export initiated for ACME-123 by raj-sre at 1864123600. job_id=EXP-221, status=queued.

jen-cs: Thanks all — I'll update SUP-4219 with contract docs and request signature for the amendment. I'll also ask the customer to confirm they are not invoking any legal hold. Will report back here when they respond. :thumbsup:
